cases.prompt: We just connected a new injection moulding machine. The tag export has names like DB12.DBX0.1 and DB12.DBD4. Can plant B reuse what we have, and what do we need to fix first?
cases.expected_output: Runs the signal analyser on the export and reports raw PLC tags as blockers. Asks for machine context (PLC program, sequence chart, handbook) because a tag list alone gives names without meanings. Proposes canonical names qualified, not coined, and checks public models (EUROMAP, OPC UA for Machinery) first. Does not fix the gap in a flow or query.

cases.prompt: The tag list from our German plant has Ruestzeit, Stueckzaehler and Heizungsart. Our Spanish plant has Contador. How do we line these up so a dashboard works at both?
cases.expected_output: Maps each local name to an English canonical name and keeps the original as an alias in the report and Machine CV. Does not machine-translate into the label without a native reading from the plant. Notes the two spellings of one counter are both aliases of the same canonical signal. Fills a binding row with unit, scale and collection method.

cases.prompt: One live signal is misspelled MachineStaus and about a dozen flows use it. Just rename it in the data-point config today, right?
cases.expected_output: Says a live signal rename is a breaking change that needs a migration, not a quick edit. Recommends renaming to canonical before new consumers use it and listing the dependent flows. A signal-standard change is a consultation decided by the IIAE; the agent only proposes.

cases.prompt: Write the Node-RED function that unpacks sysTime and publishes a delta of the part counter.
cases.expected_output: Does not do signal standardization. Routes the request to the flow-building skill (mi-flow), mentioning only that canonical names and units come from the signal report.
